[B43]: add mac80211-based driver for modern BCM43xx devices

Signed-off-by: Michael Buesch <mb@bu3sch.de>
Signed-off-by:
bic_trace_step.reason: The function b43_rx() at lines 495-503 uses a firmware-controlled key index (keyidx) to access dev->key[keyidx] without a enforcing bounds check. The only check is B43_WARN_ON(keyidx >= dev->max_nr_keys) at line 501, which is a non-enforcing warning and does not prevent out-of-bounds access in production builds. Therefore, the vulnerable construct is present and the fix (a proper bounds check that prevents the access) is absent.

bic_trace_step.reason: At line 581, the code uses a B43_WARN_ON(keyidx >= ARRAY_SIZE(dev->key)) which is a non-enforcing warning. Immediately after, at line 583, it uses keyidx to access dev->key[keyidx] without any actual bounds check. This is the vulnerable construct described in the root cause: a firmware-controlled key index is used to index an array without proper bounds enforcement, allowing an out-of-bounds read in production builds. No fix is present; only a warning is emitted.
